earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: MIAMI – October 27, 2026 – Royal Caribbean Group (NYSE: RCL) today reported third quarter Earnings per Share ("EPS") of $6.45 and Adjusted EPS of $6.57.
Total revenue was $5.6 billion, a 9% increase year over year.
Net Income was $1.7 billion or $6.45 per share, Adjusted Net Income was $1.8 billion or $6.57 per share, and Adjusted EBITDA was $2.5 billion.
Net Income for the third quarter of 2026 was $1.7 billion or $6.45 per share compared to Net Income of $1.6 billion or $5.74 per share for the same period in the prior year.
Adjusted Net Income was $1.8 billion or $6.57 per share for the third quarter of 2026 compared to Adjusted Net Income of $1.6 billion or $5.75 per share for the same period in the prior year.

quotes.text: Our third quarter results reflect continued strong consumer demand for our vacation experiences and the accelerated momentum across our industry leading brands.
quotes.by: Jason Liberty, Chairman and CEO, Royal Caribbean Group

outlook: The company now expects full year Adjusted EPS to be in the range of $17.85 to $17.95.
Revenue is expected to grow 9% year over year.
Net Yields are expected to increase approximately 2.7% as-reported and approximately 2.1% in Constant Currency.
NCC, exclud ing Fuel, per APCD are expected to increase approximately 0.4% as-reported and be approximately flat in Constant Currency.

items.heading: The risk factors set forth below and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are important factors that could cause actual results to differ from expected or historical results. It is not possible to predict or identify all such risks. There may be additional risks that we consider not to be material, or which are not known, and any of these risks could affect our operations.

The ordering of the risk factors set forth below is not intended to reflect a risk's potential likelihood or magnitude. See Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations for a cautionary note regarding forward-looking statements.

Adverse economic or other conditions could reduce the demand for cruises and passenger spending, adversely impacting our operating results, cash flows and financial condition including impairing the value of our goodwill, ships, trademarks and other assets and potentially affecting other critical accounting estimates where the impact may be material to our operating results.
items.group: Macroeconomic, Business, Market and Operational Risks

items.heading: Our operating costs could increase due to market forces and economic or geopolitical factors beyond our control.
items.group: Macroeconomic, Business, Market and Operational Risks

items.heading: Price increases for commercial airline services for our guests or major changes or reduction in commercial airline services and/or availability could adversely impact the demand for cruises and undermine our ability to provide reasonably priced vacation packages to our guests.
items.group: Macroeconomic, Business, Market and Operational Risks

items.heading: Terrorist attacks, war, and other similar events could have a material adverse impact on our business and results of operations.
